hindi: वे ही अदिति के पुत्र मरणशील मनुष्य को जीवन के लिए निरन्तर प्रकाश प्रदान करते हैं।
english: For they, the sons of Aditi, bestow unceasing light on the mortal, that he may live.
notes: pra goes with yacchanti (pra-√yam, 'bestow'); 'jīvase' is a Vedic infinitive 'for living'. Accent marks kept in src only.
lines_deva: ते हि पु॒त्रासो॒ अदि॑तेः॒ प्र जी॒वसे॒ मर्त्या॑य । ज्योति॒र्यच्छ॒न्त्यज॑स्रम्
lines_iast: te hi pu̱trāso̱ adi̭te̱ḥ pra jī̱vase̱ martyā̭ya | jyoti̱ryaccha̱ntyaja̭sram

hindi: हे इन्द्र, तुम कभी बाँझ नहीं हो; तुम दाता उपासक की सेवा करते हो। हे मघवन्, और समीप, और भी समीप, और भी अधिक; देव का तुम्हारा दान निश्चय ही प्रदान किया जाता है।
english: You are never barren, O Indra; you attend the worshipper who gives. Nearer and nearer still, O Maghavan, and more: the god's gift of yours is bestowed.
notes: 'upopennu' resolves as upa upa it nu (t before n assimilated: upopet nu > upopen nu). 'starīḥ' taken as 'barren' (with na). pṛcyate: 'is bestowed / is filled' (√pṛc 'mix, bestow'); 'devasya' may refer to Indra; ambiguity not resolved.
lines_deva: क॒दा च॒न स्त॒रीर॑सि॒ नेन्द्र॑ सश्चसि दा॒शुषे॑ । उ॒पोपेन्नु म॑घव॒न् भूय॒ इन्नु ते॒ दानं॑ दे॒वस्य॑ पृच्यते
lines_iast: ka̱dā ca̱na sta̱rīra̭si̱ nendra̭ saścasi dā̱śuṣḙ | u̱popennu ma̭ghava̱n bhūya̱ innu te̱ dāna̭ṃ de̱vasya̭ pṛcyate

words.gram: 3 sg. subj./inj. (Vedic, often glossed opt.) pra-√cud (caus.)

hindi: हम सविता देव के उस श्रेष्ठ तेज का ध्यान करते हैं, जो हमारी बुद्धियों को प्रेरित करे।
english: We meditate on that excellent radiance of the god Savitṛ, who may impel our thoughts.
notes: Gāyatrī mantra. 'yaḥ' (who) may refer to Savitṛ; 'bhargas' as accusative object of dhīmahi. 'dhīmahi' also read as 'we contemplate'.
lines_deva: तत्स॑वि॒तुर्वरे॑ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि । धियो॒ यो न॑ः प्रचो॒दया॑त्
lines_iast: tatsa̭vi̱turvarḙṇya̱ṃ bhargo̭ de̱vasya̭ dhīmahi | dhiyo̱ yo na̭ḥ praco̱dayā̭t

hindi: तुम्हारा अहिंस्य रथ सब ओर से हमें घेर ले, जिससे तुम दाता उपासकों की रक्षा करते हो।
english: May your chariot, hard to harm, encompass us on all sides, by which you protect the worshippers who give.
notes: 'ratho'smā~2' read as rathaḥ asmān (pluti mark '~2' in src). 'dūḍabha' rendered 'hard to deceive/harm'; sense of the epithet is traditional. The addressee is not named in the unit.
lines_deva: परि॑ ते दू॒डभो॒ रथो॒ऽस्माँ२  अ॑श्नोतु वि॒श्वत॑ः । येन॒ रक्ष॑सि दा॒शुष॑ः
lines_iast: pari̭ te dū̱ḍabho̱ ratho̱'smā~2  a̭śnotu vi̱śvata̭ḥ | yena̱ rakṣa̭si dā̱śuṣa̭ḥ

hindi: भूः, भुवः, स्वः। मैं सन्तानों से उत्तम सन्तानवाला, वीरों से उत्तम वीरोंवाला और पोषणों से उत्तम पोषणवाला होऊँ। हे नर्य, मेरी सन्तान की रक्षा करो; हे शंस्य, मेरे पशुओं की रक्षा करो; हे अथर्य, मेरे अन्न की रक्षा करो।
english: Bhūḥ, Bhuvaḥ, Svaḥ. May I be rich in offspring through offspring, rich in heroes through heroes, well nourished through nourishments. O manly one, protect my offspring; O praiseworthy one, protect my cattle; O atharya, protect my food.
notes: 'bhūrbhuvaḥ' resolved bhūḥ bhuvaḥ (the first token is one src token, so the two words share it). 'atharya' is an obscure epithet (kept untranslated); 'pitu' = food. The three vocatives address one deity not named in the unit.
lines_deva: भूर्भुव॒ः स्व॒ः सुप्र॒जाः प्र॒जाभि॑ः स्याᳪ  सु॒वीरो॑ वी॒रैः सु॒पोष॒ः पोषै॑ः
नर्य॑ प्र॒जां मे॑ पाहि  शᳪस्य॑ प॒शून्मे॑ पा॒ह्यथ॑र्य पि॒तुं मे॑ पाहि
lines_iast: bhūrbhuva̱ḥ sva̱ḥ supra̱jāḥ pra̱jābhi̭ḥ syāᳪ  su̱vīro̭ vī̱raiḥ su̱poṣa̱ḥ poṣai̭ḥ
narya̭ pra̱jāṃ mḙ pāhi  śaᳪsya̭ pa̱śūnmḙ pā̱hyatha̭rya pi̱tuṃ mḙ pāhi

hindi: हम सर्वस्व-स्वामी, हमारे लिए धन के सर्वोत्तम प्राप्त करानेवाले के पास आए हैं। हे अग्नि, हे सम्राट्, हमारे लिए तेज और बल हमें प्रदान करो।
english: We have come to the all-possessing one, the best finder of wealth for us. O Agni, sovereign, extend to us splendour and might.
notes: 'viśvaveda' may also mean 'all-knowing'. The object of ā ganma (Agni understood) is not stated; 'abhi ... ā yacchasva' rendered 'extend to us'. The first ā goes with ganma (ā-√gam), the last ā with yacchasva; viśva-vedas = all-possessing/all-knowing, not "owner of everything".
lines_deva: आ ग॑न्म वि॒श्ववे॑दसम॒स्मभ्यं॑ वसु॒वित्त॑मम् । अग्ने॑ सम्राड॒भि द्यु॒म्नम॒भि सह॒ आ य॑च्छस्व
lines_iast: ā ga̭nma vi̱śvavḙdasama̱smabhya̭ṃ vasu̱vitta̭mam | agnḙ samrāḍa̱bhi dyu̱mnama̱bhi saha̱ ā ya̭cchasva

hindi: यह अग्नि गृहपति, गार्हपत्य है, सन्तान के लिए धन का सर्वोत्तम प्राप्त करानेवाला है। हे अग्नि, हे गृहपति, हमारे लिए तेज और बल प्रदान करो।
english: This Agni, the house-lord, the Gārhapatya, is the best finder of wealth for offspring. O Agni, house-lord, extend to us splendour and might.
notes: 'prajāyā' is taken as a Vedic form of the dative prajāyai (genitive/ablative prajāyāḥ also possible).
lines_deva: अ॒यम॒ग्निर्गृ॒हप॑ति॒र्गार्ह॑पत्यः प्र॒जाया॑ वसु॒वित्त॑मः । अग्ने॑ गृहपते॒ऽभि द्यु॒म्नम॒भि सह॒ आ य॑च्छस्व
lines_iast: a̱yama̱gnirgṛ̱hapa̭ti̱rgārha̭patyaḥ pra̱jāyā̭ vasu̱vitta̭maḥ | agnḙ gṛhapate̱'bhi dyu̱mnama̱bhi saha̱ ā ya̭cchasva

hindi: यह अग्नि पुरीष्य, धनवान् और पुष्टि बढ़ानेवाला है। हे अग्नि, हे पुरीष्य, हमारे लिए तेज और बल प्रदान करो।
english: This Agni, the Purīṣya, rich in wealth, increaser of prosperity. O Agni, O Purīṣya, extend to us splendour and might.
notes: 'purīṣya' (epithet) left untranslated; its exact sense (relating to loose earth/purīṣa) is not given by the unit.
lines_deva: अ॒यम॒ग्निः पु॑री॒ष्यो॒ रयि॒मान्  पु॑ष्टि॒वर्ध॑नः । अग्ने॑ पुरीष्या॒भि द्यु॒म्नम॒भि सह॒ आ य॑च्छस्व
lines_iast: a̱yama̱gniḥ pṷrī̱ṣyo̱ rayi̱mān  pṷṣṭi̱vardha̭naḥ | agnḙ purīṣyā̱bhi dyu̱mnama̱bhi saha̱ ā ya̭cchasva

hindi: हे घरो, मत डरो, मत काँपो; हम बल धारण करते हुए आते हैं। मैं तुम्हारे लिए बल धारण करता हुआ, प्रसन्न मनवाला, उत्तम बुद्धिवाला, मन से आनन्दित होकर घरों में आता हूँ।
english: O houses, do not fear, do not tremble; bearing vigour we come. Bearing vigour for you, well-disposed, of good understanding, I come to the houses, rejoicing in mind.
notes: 'ema̭si' = ā + imasi; 'gṛhānaimi' = gṛhān + ā + emi (ā+e gives ai). 'vaḥ' dative 'for you' (or 'your').
lines_deva: गृहा॒ मा बि॑भीत॒ मा वे॑पध्व॒मूर्जं॑ बिभ्रत॒ एम॑सि । ऊर्जं॒ बिभ्र॑द्वः सु॒मना॑ः सुमे॒धा गृ॒हानैमि॒ मन॑सा॒ मोद॑मानः
lines_iast: gṛhā̱ mā bi̭bhīta̱ mā vḙpadhva̱mūrja̭ṃ bibhrata̱ ema̭si | ūrja̱ṃ bibhra̭dvaḥ su̱manā̭ḥ sume̱dhā gṛ̱hānaimi̱ mana̭sā̱ moda̭mānaḥ

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. pra-√vas

hindi: जिन घरों को परदेस में रहनेवाला स्मरण करता है, जिनमें सद्भाव बहुत है, उन घरों को हम बुलाते हैं; वे जानते हुए हमें जानें।
english: We invite the houses which the one living abroad remembers, in which there is abundant goodwill; let them, knowing, know us.
notes: 'adhyeti' taken as adhi-√i 'remembers'. 'jānataḥ' taken as nom. pl. agreeing with te (the houses); another reading takes it as genitive 'of us who know'. 'yeṣu' = in which.
lines_deva: येषा॑म॒ध्येति॑ प्र॒वस॒न्येषु॑ सौमन॒सो ब॒हुः । गृ॒हानुप॑ह्वयामहे॒ ते नो॑ जानन्तु जान॒तः
lines_iast: yeṣā̭ma̱dhyeti̭ pra̱vasa̱nyeṣṷ saumana̱so ba̱huḥ | gṛ̱hānupa̭hvayāmahe̱ te no̭ jānantu jāna̱taḥ

words.gloss: I resort to, take refuge in

hindi: यहाँ गौएँ बुलाई गई हैं, बकरी और भेड़ें बुलाई गई हैं; और हमारे घरों में अन्न का मधुर रस भी बुलाया गया है। कल्याण और शान्ति के लिए मैं तुम्हारी शरण लेता हूँ: मंगलकारी, सुखकर, शंयु, शंयु।
english: Invited here are the cows; invited are the goats and sheep; and the sweet essence of food is invited in our houses. For security and for peace I resort to you: the auspicious, the helpful, welfare, welfare.
notes: 'śaṃyoḥ' is obscure here (śaṃ ca yoś ca 'weal and well-being' in the tradition); rendered 'welfare', case uncertain. The grammar of 'upahūtā' in the first pāda (cows) assumed as nom. pl. 'kīlāla' = sweet drink / sweet food-essence.
lines_deva: उप॑हूता इ॒ह गाव॒ उप॑हूता अजा॒वय॑ः । अथो॒ अन्न॑स्य की॒लाल॒ उप॑हूतो गृ॒हेषु॑ नः । क्षेमा॑य व॒ः शान्त्यै॒ प्रप॑द्ये शि॒वᳪ  श॒ग्मᳪ शं॒योः शं॒योः
lines_iast: upa̭hūtā i̱ha gāva̱ upa̭hūtā ajā̱vaya̭ḥ | atho̱ anna̭sya kī̱lāla̱ upa̭hūto gṛ̱heṣṷ naḥ | kṣemā̭ya va̱ḥ śāntyai̱ prapa̭dye śi̱vaᳪ  śa̱gmaᳪ śa̱ṃyoḥ śa̱ṃyoḥ

hindi: हम प्रघासियों को और शत्रुओं को खा जानेवाले मरुतों को, करम्भ के साथ मिलकर बुलाते हैं।
english: We invoke the Praghāsins, and the Maruts, the devourers of foes, in accord with the gruel (karambha).
notes: 'sajoṣasaḥ' taken with the invoked ones (united with, enjoying the karambha). Praghāsin is a proper class name kept; meaning 'voracious' is the literal sense. sajoṣasaḥ is nom. or acc. pl. (same form): "in accord" refers either to us or to the Maruts; human decision.
lines_deva: प्र॒घा॒सिनो॑ हवामहे म॒रुत॑श्च रि॒शाद॑सः । क॒र॒म्भेण॑ स॒जोष॑सः
lines_iast: pra̱ghā̱sino̭ havāmahe ma̱ruta̭śca ri̱śāda̭saḥ | ka̱ra̱mbheṇa̭ sa̱joṣa̭saḥ

hindi: गाँव में, वन में, सभा में, इन्द्रिय में, जो पाप हमने किया है, उसे हम यहाँ यज्ञ द्वारा दूर करते हैं। स्वाहा।
english: Whatever sin we have committed in the village, in the forest, in the assembly, in the faculty, that we here sacrifice away. Svāhā.
notes: 'avayajāmahe' (ava-√yaj) rendered 'sacrifice away' (to expiate). 'indriye' may be 'in the sense-faculty' or 'in Indra's power'; first rendered literally. idam is rendered "here" in the translations but is the pronoun "this" (acc.); layers disagree: human check.
lines_deva: यद्ग्रामे॒ यदर॑ण्ये॒ यत्स॒भायां॒ यदि॑न्द्रि॑ये । यदेन॑श्चकृ॒मा व॒यमि॒दं तदव॑यजामहे॒ स्वाहा॑
lines_iast: yadgrāme̱ yadara̭ṇye̱ yatsa̱bhāyā̱ṃ yadi̭ndri̭ye | yadena̭ścakṛ̱mā va̱yami̱daṃ tadava̭yajāmahe̱ svāhā̭

hindi: हे इन्द्र, यहाँ युद्धों में हमें मत छोड़ो; क्योंकि हे बलवान्, देवों के साथ तुम्हारा अवया निश्चय ही है। जिस महान् और उदार (के) यव्या में हविष्मान् की वाणी मरुतों की स्तुति करती है।
english: O Indra, do not (leave) us here in the battles; for with the gods there is indeed your share (avayā), O mighty one. Of whom, the great and bountiful one, the song of the one with oblation praises the Maruts.
notes: Hard unit: the first line is a plea ('do not leave us here in the battles') with 'avayāḥ' read as the share/propitiatory portion; 'yavyā' (stream/river?) and the construction of line 2 are uncertain; translation is tentative. The unit looks like two distinct verse-halves of different tone; no GROUPING change proposed. Line 2 is unresolved: yavyā is a nominative in the gram label but is not translated in English and the Hindi has a bracket artefact; treat the translation of this unit as tentative.
lines_deva: मो षू ण॑ इ॒न्द्रात्र॑ पृ॒त्सु दे॒वैरस्ति॒ हि ष्मा॑ ते शुष्मिन्नव॒याः
म॒हश्चि॒द्यस्य॑ मी॒ढुषो॑ य॒व्या ह॒विष्म॑तो म॒रुतो॒ वन्द॑ते॒ गीः
lines_iast: mo ṣū ṇa̭ i̱ndrātra̭ pṛ̱tsu de̱vairasti̱ hi ṣmā̭ te śuṣminnava̱yāḥ
ma̱haści̱dyasya̭ mī̱ḍhuṣo̭ ya̱vyā ha̱viṣma̭to ma̱ruto̱ vanda̭te̱ gīḥ

hindi: कर्म करनेवालों ने सुखकारी वाणी के साथ कर्म सम्पन्न कर दिया है। देवों के लिए कर्म करके, हे साथियो, अपने घर को चले जाओ।
english: The doers of the rite have performed the rite together with joy-bringing speech. Having performed the rite for the gods, go home, O companions.
notes: 'sacābhuvaḥ' (sacā + bhū) taken as 'companions, those who are together'; 'astam' = home.
lines_deva: अक्र॒न्  कर्म॑ कर्म॒कृत॑ः स॒ह वा॒चा म॑यो॒भुवा॑ । दे॒वेभ्य॒ः कर्म॑ कृ॒त्वास्तं॒ प्रेत॑ सचाभुवः
lines_iast: akra̱n  karma̭ karma̱kṛta̭ḥ sa̱ha vā̱cā ma̭yo̱bhuvā̭ | de̱vebhya̱ḥ karma̭ kṛ̱tvāsta̱ṃ preta̭ sacābhuvaḥ

hindi: हे अवभृथ, हे निचुम्पुण, तुम निचेरु हो, निचुम्पुण हो। देवों के साथ मैंने देवों द्वारा किए पाप को दूर किया है; मनुष्यों के साथ मनुष्यों द्वारा किए पाप को (दूर किया है)। हे पुरुरावण के देव, हानि से रक्षा करो।
english: O Avabhṛtha, O Nicumpuṇa, you are Nicera, Nicumpuṇa. With the gods I have removed the sin done by the gods; with mortals, the sin done by mortals. O god, of Pururāvan, protect (me) from harm.
notes: Epithets nicumpuṇa and nicera, and 'pururāvṇaḥ', are obscure and left untranslated. 'ava ... ayāsiṣam' read as ava-√yā 'I have removed/appeased'; 'martyakṛtaṃ' parallels devakṛtam, so enaḥ is understood. Grouping: unit has 2 printed lines which together make the full formula. pururāvṇaḥ may be a second ablative/genitive ("from Pururāvṇa") rather than a name qualifying deva; uncertain.
lines_deva: अव॑भृथ निचुम्पुण निचे॒रुर॑सि निचुम्पु॒णः
अव॑ दे॒वैर्दे॒वकृ॑त॒मेनो॑ऽयासिष॒मव॒ मर्त्यै॒र्मर्त्य॑कृतं पुरु॒राव्णो॑ देव रि॒षस्पा॑हि
lines_iast: ava̭bhṛtha nicumpuṇa nice̱rura̭si nicumpu̱ṇaḥ
ava̭ de̱vairde̱vakṛ̭ta̱meno̭'yāsiṣa̱mava̱ martyai̱rmartya̭kṛtaṃ puru̱rāvṇo̭ deva ri̱ṣaspā̭hi

hindi: हे पूर्ण कलछी, दूर उड़ जाओ; भली-भाँति भरी हुई लौट आओ। जैसे मूल्य के बदले, हम दोनों अन्न और बल का विनिमय करें, हे शतक्रतु।
english: O full ladle, fly away; well filled, fly back again. As if for a price, let us two exchange food and strength, O hundred-powered one.
notes: 'vasneva' = vasnā iva. 'śatakrato' (an epithet) rendered 'hundred-powered'; the addressee is not named in the unit. Text: 'vikrīṇāvahā' written with ā for -ai.
lines_deva: पू॒र्णा द॑र्वि॒ परा॑ पत॒ सुपू॑र्णा॒ पुन॒रा प॑त । व॒स्नेव॒ विक्री॑णावहा॒ इष॒मूर्ज॑ᳪ  शतक्रतो
lines_iast: pū̱rṇā da̭rvi̱ parā̭ pata̱ supṷ̄rṇā̱ puna̱rā pa̭ta | va̱sneva̱ vikrī̭ṇāvahā̱ iṣa̱mūrja̭ᳪ  śatakrato

hindi: मुझे दो, मैं तुम्हें देता हूँ; मेरे लिए रखो, मैं तुम्हारे लिए रखता हूँ। और तुम मेरे लिए 'निहार' ले जाओ, मैं तुम्हारे लिए 'निहार' ले जाऊँ। स्वाहा।
english: Give to me, I give to you; place for me, I place for you. And may you carry off the nihāra for me, may I carry off the nihāra for you. Svāhā.

text_flags.why: possible typo; 'ni te dadhe' (I place for you) parallels 'ni me dhehi' and the other 'te'

notes: 'nihāra' kept untranslated (exchange/carrying off); 'ni ... dhā' and 'ni ... hṛ' read as 'place' and 'carry off'. Exact sense obscure.
lines_deva: दे॒हि मे॒ ददा॑मि ते॒ नि मे॑ धेहि॒ नि त दधे । नि॒हारं॑ च॒ हरा॑सि मे नि॒हारं॒ नि ह॑राणि ते॒ स्वाहा॑
lines_iast: de̱hi me̱ dadā̭mi te̱ ni mḙ dhehi̱ ni ta dadhe | ni̱hāra̭ṃ ca̱ harā̭si me ni̱hāra̱ṃ ni ha̭rāṇi te̱ svāhā̭

hindi: उन्होंने खा लिया है और आनन्दित हो गए हैं; प्रियों ने अपने को झाड़ लिया है। स्वयं प्रकाशमान विप्रों ने नवीनतम स्तुति से स्तवन किया है। हे इन्द्र, अब अपने दोनों घोड़ों को जोतो।
english: They have eaten, they have rejoiced; the dear ones have shaken themselves off. The self-radiant inspired ones have praised with the newest hymn. Now, O Indra, yoke your two bay horses.

text_flags.why: possible; the attested wording is 'naviṣṭhayā matī' (with the newest hymn); 'niviṣṭhayā' is not a natural form

notes: 'ava ... adhūṣata' read as 'shook off' (tmesis); 'priyāḥ' taken as nom. pl. 'the dear ones' (subject, possibly the Fathers or sages); alternative: 'priyā' as acc. object. 'yojā' taken as imperative 'yoke'. 'akṣan' read as aorist 'have eaten' (√ad/√ghas).
lines_deva: अक्ष॒न्नमी॑मदन्त॒ ह्यव॑ प्रि॒या अ॑धूषत
अस्तो॑षत॒ स्वभा॑नवो॒ विप्रा॒ निवि॑ष्ठया म॒ती योजा॒ न्वि॒न्द्र ते॒ हरी॑
lines_iast: akṣa̱nnamī̭madanta̱ hyava̭ pri̱yā a̭dhūṣata
asto̭ṣata̱ svabhā̭navo̱ viprā̱ nivi̭ṣṭhayā ma̱tī yojā̱ nvi̱ndra te̱ harī̭

hindi: हे मघवन्, सुन्दर रूपवाले तुम्हारी हम स्तुति करें। हे भरे हुए रथ-आसनवाले, स्तुति पाकर तुम अब निश्चय ही हमारी इच्छाओं के अनुसार जाते हो; हे इन्द्र, अब अपने दोनों घोड़ों को जोतो।
english: May we praise you, O Maghavan, beautiful to behold. Praised, O you of the full chariot-seat, you go forth now according to (our) wishes. Now, O Indra, yoke your two bay horses.
notes: 'vaśā~2' read as vaśān (pluti); 'vaśān anu' = 'according to wishes'. 'yojā' = imperative 'yoke' (Vedic lengthened form).
lines_deva: सु॒स॒न्दृशं॑ त्वा व॒यं मघ॑वन्वन्दिषी॒महि॑
प्र नू॒नं पू॒र्णब॑न्धुर स्तु॒तो या॑सि॒ वशाँ॒२  अनु॒ योजा॒ न्वि॒न्द्र ते॒ हरी॑
lines_iast: su̱sa̱ndṛśa̭ṃ tvā va̱yaṃ magha̭vanvandiṣī̱mahi̭
pra nū̱naṃ pū̱rṇaba̭ndhura stu̱to yā̭si̱ vaśā̱~2  anu̱ yojā̱ nvi̱ndra te̱ harī̭

hindi: हम अब नाराशंस स्तोम से और पितरों के मन्त्रों से मन को पुकारकर लौटाते हैं।
english: We now call back the mind with the Nārāśaṃsa praise-song and with the thoughts of the Fathers.

text_flags.why: typo; 'j' for 'ṃ' (Nārāśaṃsa, relating to praise of men)

notes: 'ā hvāmahe' read as 'call back, call hither'. 'manma' = thought / hymn.
lines_deva: मनो॒ न्वाह्वा॑महे नाराश॒jसेन॒ स्तोमे॑न । पि॑तॄ॒णां च॒ मन्म॑भिः
lines_iast: mano̱ nvāhvā̭mahe nārāśa̱jsena̱ stomḙna | pi̭tṝ̱ṇāṃ ca̱ manma̭bhiḥ

hindi: हमारा मन फिर लौट आए, संकल्प के लिए, दक्षता के लिए, जीने के लिए, और देर तक सूर्य को देखने के लिए।
english: May the mind come back to us again, for resolve, for ability, for living, and to see the sun for long.
notes: 'na' is an enclitic form of 'nas'. It is normal Vedic usage, not an error.
lines_deva: आ न॑ एतु॒ मन॒ः पुन॒ः क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॑य जी॒वसे॑ । ज्योक् च॒  सूर्यं॑ दृ॒शे
lines_iast: ā na̭ etu̱ mana̱ḥ puna̱ḥ kratve̱ dakṣā̭ya jī̱vasḙ | jyok ca̱  sūrya̭ṃ dṛ̱śe

hindi: हे पितरो, दिव्य जन हमें फिर मन प्रदान करे; हम जीवित समूह का साथ पाएँ।
english: O Fathers, may the divine host give us the mind again; may we join the living company.
notes: 'jīvaṃ vrātam' rendered 'the living company'; the sense of 'sacemahi' ('attend, be joined to') kept general.
lines_deva: पुन॑र्नः पितरो॒ मनो॒ ददा॑तु दैव्यो॒ जन॑ः । जी॒वं व्रात॑ᳪ  सचेमहि
lines_iast: puna̭rnaḥ pitaro̱ mano̱ dadā̭tu daivyo̱ jana̭ḥ | jī̱vaṃ vrāta̭ᳪ  sacemahi

hindi: हे सोम, तुम्हारे व्रत में अपने शरीरों में मन को धारण करते हुए हम सन्तानवान् होकर साथ पाएँ।
english: O Soma, in your ordinance, bearing the mind in our bodies, may we, possessed of offspring, attend.
notes: Object of 'sacemahi' is not expressed; 'vrata' = ordinance / law.
lines_deva: व॒यᳪ  सो॑म व्र॒ते तव॒ मन॑स्त॒नूषु॒ बिभ्र॑तः । प्र॒जाव॑न्तः सचेमहि
lines_iast: va̱yaᳪ  so̭ma vra̱te tava̱ mana̭sta̱nūṣu̱ bibhra̭taḥ | pra̱jāva̭ntaḥ sacemahi

hindi: हे रुद्र, यह तुम्हारा भाग है, बहन अम्बिका के साथ; उसे स्वीकार करो। स्वाहा। हे रुद्र, यह तुम्हारा भाग है; चूहा तुम्हारा पशु है।
english: This is your share, O Rudra, together with the sister Ambikā; enjoy it. Svāhā. This is your share, O Rudra; the mouse is your animal.
notes: 'svasrā' is instrumental 'with the sister'; the speaker's addressee 'your sister Ambikā' is as the line states.
lines_deva: ए॒ष ते॑ रुद्र भा॒गः स॒ह स्वस्राम्बि॑कया॒ तं जु॑षस्व॒ स्वाहै॒ष ते॑ रुद्र भा॒ग आ॒खुस्ते॑ प॒शुः
lines_iast: e̱ṣa tḙ rudra bhā̱gaḥ sa̱ha svasrāmbi̭kayā̱ taṃ jṷṣasva̱ svāhai̱ṣa tḙ rudra bhā̱ga ā̱khustḙ pa̱śuḥ

hindi: हमने रुद्र को, त्र्यम्बक देव को, प्रसन्न कर लिया है, ताकि वह हमें अधिक श्रेयस्कर करे, ताकि वह हमें और श्रेष्ठ करे, ताकि वह हमें दृढ़ निश्चयी बनाए।
english: We have appeased Rudra, the god Tryambaka, so that he may make us better off, so that he may make us more excellent, so that he may make us resolute.
notes: 'adīmahi' (ava-√dā/√dī) is uncertain: rendered 'appeased' on the usual sense of the formula. 'vasyasaskarat' read as vasyasaḥ karat / 'make better'; 'śreyasaskarat' parallel. Alternative: 'vasyas-' and 'śreyas-' as comparative stems used adverbially.
lines_deva: अव॑ रु॒द्रम॑दीम॒ह्यव॑ दे॒वं त्र्य॑म्बकम् । यथा॑ नो॒ वस्य॑स॒स्कर॒द्यथा॑ न॒ः श्रेय॑स॒स्कर॒द्यथा॑ नो व्यवसा॒यया॑त्
lines_iast: ava̭ ru̱drama̭dīma̱hyava̭ de̱vaṃ trya̭mbakam | yathā̭ no̱ vasya̭sa̱skara̱dyathā̭ na̱ḥ śreya̭sa̱skara̱dyathā̭ no vyavasā̱yayā̭t

hindi: तुम औषध हो; गौ के लिए, घोड़े के लिए, पुरुष के लिए औषध हो; मेढ़े के लिए, भेड़ के लिए सुख हो।
english: You are a remedy: a remedy for the cow, for the horse, for the man; ease for the ram, for the ewe.
notes: The unit has no verb after 'sukham'; 'asi' is understood. 'bheṣaja' rendered literally as remedy.
lines_deva: भे॒ष॒जम॑सि भेष॒जं गवेऽश्वा॑य॒ पुरु॑षाय भेष॒जम् । सु॒खं मे॒षाय॑ मेष्यै
lines_iast: bhe̱ṣa̱jama̭si bheṣa̱jaṃ gave'śvā̭ya̱ purṷṣāya bheṣa̱jam | su̱khaṃ me̱ṣāya̭ meṣyai

hindi: हम सुगन्धित, पुष्टि बढ़ानेवाले त्र्यम्बक का यजन करते हैं। जैसे ककड़ी अपने बन्धन से, वैसे मैं मृत्यु से मुक्त हो जाऊँ, अमृत से नहीं। हम सुगन्धित, पति प्राप्त करानेवाले त्र्यम्बक का यजन करते हैं। जैसे ककड़ी अपने बन्धन से, वैसे मैं यहाँ से मुक्त हो जाऊँ, वहाँ से नहीं।
english: We sacrifice to Tryambaka, the fragrant, the increaser of prosperity. Like a cucumber from its stalk, may I be freed from death, not from immortality. We sacrifice to Tryambaka, the fragrant, the finder of a husband. Like a cucumber from its stalk, may I be freed from here, not from there.
notes: 'bandhana' rendered 'stalk' (literally 'bond'). 'pativedanam' = 'husband-finding'. The two lines are two variants of one formula; no GROUPING change.
lines_deva: त्र्य॑म्बकं यजामहे सुग॒न्धिं पु॑ष्टि॒वर्ध॑नम् । उ॒र्वा॒रु॒कमि॑व॒ बन्ध॑नान्मृ॒त्योर्मु॑क्षीय॒ मामृता॑त्
त्र्य॑म्बकं यजामहे सुग॒न्धिं प॑ति॒वेद॑नम् । उ॒र्वा॒रु॒कमि॑व॒ बन्ध॑नादि॒तो मु॑क्षीय॒ मामुत॑ः
lines_iast: trya̭mbakaṃ yajāmahe suga̱ndhiṃ pṷṣṭi̱vardha̭nam | u̱rvā̱ru̱kami̭va̱ bandha̭nānmṛ̱tyormṷkṣīya̱ māmṛtā̭t
trya̭mbakaṃ yajāmahe suga̱ndhiṃ pa̭ti̱veda̭nam | u̱rvā̱ru̱kami̭va̱ bandha̭nādi̱to mṷkṣīya̱ māmuta̭ḥ

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. a-√hiṃs

hindi: हे रुद्र, यह तुम्हारा पाथेय है; उसके साथ मूजवान् के पार दूर चले जाओ। धनुष की डोरी उतारे हुए, पिनाक को आश्रय बनाए हुए, चर्म धारण किए हुए, हमें हानि न पहुँचाते हुए, मंगलकारी होकर परे चले जाओ।
english: This is your provision, O Rudra; with it go far beyond Mūjavat. With bow unstrung, having the Pināka as resting-place, wearing a hide, not harming us, auspicious, go beyond.
notes: 'avasa' rendered 'provision' (also 'stopping-place'); 'pinākāvasaḥ' and 'avatatadhanvā' are doubtful in sense: other readings 'with the Pināka laid down'. Mūjavat taken as a name (a mountain, per the tradition), not stated in the unit. Two lines of one formula; no GROUPING change.
lines_deva: ए॒तत्ते॑ रुद्राव॒सं तेन॑ प॒रो मूज॑व॒तोऽती॑हि
अव॑ततधन्वा॒ पिना॑कावस॒ः कृत्ति॑वासा॒ अहि॑ᳪसन्नः शि॒वोऽती॑हि
lines_iast: e̱tattḙ rudrāva̱saṃ tena̭ pa̱ro mūja̭va̱to'tī̭hi
ava̭tatadhanvā̱ pinā̭kāvasa̱ḥ kṛtti̭vāsā̱ ahi̭ᳪsannaḥ śi̱vo'tī̭hi

hindi: जमदग्नि का त्र्यायुष, कश्यप का त्र्यायुष; देवों में जो त्र्यायुष है, वह त्र्यायुष हमारा हो।
english: Threefold life of Jamadagni, threefold life of Kaśyapa; the threefold life that is among the gods, may that be ours: threefold life.
notes: 'tryāyuṣam' = threefold lifetime (three-fold life-span). Repeated in each pāda.
lines_deva: त्र्या॑यु॒षं ज॒मद॑ग्नेः क॒श्यप॑स्य त्र्यायु॒षम् । यद्दे॒वेषु॑ त्र्यायु॒षं तन्नो॑ अस्तु त्र्यायु॒षम्
lines_iast: tryā̭yu̱ṣaṃ ja̱mada̭gneḥ ka̱śyapa̭sya tryāyu̱ṣam | yadde̱veṣṷ tryāyu̱ṣaṃ tanno̭ astu tryāyu̱ṣam

words.gram: n. dat. sg. (su + vīrya, compound noun)

hindi: तुम नाम से शिव हो; कुल्हाड़ी तुम्हारा पिता है; तुम्हें नमस्कार हो; मुझे हानि मत पहुँचाओ। मैं आयु के लिए, अन्न-भोग के लिए, सन्तान उत्पत्ति के लिए, धन की वृद्धि के लिए, उत्तम सन्तान के लिए और उत्तम वीर्य के लिए लौटाता हूँ।
english: You are Śiva by name; the axe is your father; homage to you; do not harm me. I turn (it) back for life, for the eating of food, for procreation, for the increase of wealth, for good offspring, for heroic strength.
notes: Object of 'ni vartayāmi' is not stated in the unit; rendered '(it)'. 'svadhiti' = axe or knife. 'mā mā': first mā is 'me', second the prohibitive.
lines_deva: शि॒वो नामा॑सि॒ स्वधि॑तिस्ते पि॒ता नम॑स्ते अस्तु॒ मा मा॑ हिᳪसीः
नि व॑र्तयाम्यायु॑षे॒ऽन्नाद्या॑य॒ प्रजन॑नाय रा॒यस्पोषा॑य सुप्रजा॒स्त्वाय॑ सु॒वीर्या॑य
lines_iast: śi̱vo nāmā̭si̱ svadhi̭tiste pi̱tā nama̭ste astu̱ mā mā̭ hiᳪsīḥ
ni va̭rtayāmyāyṷṣe̱'nnādyā̭ya̱ prajana̭nāya rā̱yaspoṣā̭ya suprajā̱stvāya̭ su̱vīryā̭ya
